title: Buyers
emptyDescription: Invite the businesses you supply so they can order from your catalogue.
emptyDisconnectedDescription: Buyers you disconnect from stay listed here with their history.

invite.title: Invite a new buyer
invite.description: They get an email to set up their business on Narudžbine. You are connected once they finish.
invite.emailHint: The person who will own the buyer's account.
invite.emailHintReconnect: Must be the email of their owner or an admin; only that person can accept.

invitations.note: Invitations reserve no plan capacity: your buyer limit is checked when an invitation is accepted. Failed or unknown delivery is never retried automatically.
invitations.emptyDescription: Invitations you send show here until they are accepted, revoked or expire.
invitations.resendUncertain: We couldn't confirm the resend. Retry to send the same request again.
invitations.revokeDescription: The emailed link stops working. You can send a new invitation later.

detail.notFoundDescription: This relationship doesn't exist or isn't yours.
detail.noPartnerDetails: Company details aren't available for this relationship.
detail.reconnectDescription: Send {name} an invitation to trade again. Their owner or an admin accepts it from the email.

agreed.title: Agreed prices
agreed.description: Negotiated unit prices for this buyer. Edit them on each product's page.
agreed.reviewDescription: After reconnecting, agreed prices don't apply until you confirm them. Confirm the ones that still hold for {name}.
agreed.reviewEmpty: After reconnecting, confirm that {name} has no agreed prices to restore.
